slides.title: The countdown
slides.body: You know exactly how many days, watches and mess dinners are left.

slides.title: Handover notes
slides.body: Pages of notes for your relief. Every quirk of every printer, pump and passage plan.

slides.title: Packing
slides.body: Months of life into one suitcase. The souvenirs somehow never fit.

slides.title: Relief arrives
slides.body: The best handshake of the whole contract. Then two hours of talking non-stop.

slides.title: The airport
slides.body: First real coffee, first fast Wi-Fi, first sleep that isn't split around a watch.

slides.a: Once you're home, the work is done.
slides.b: CV, sea time and certificates still need updating.

slides.question: Which stage are you in right now?
slides.line: Ocean Link does the after-sign-off admin for you.
